frontendCertificationSourceAnchorRule: Before spreadsheet-admission can run, commit the adapter from the clean baseline worktree and replace null with that exact reviewed successor SHA. Bind only certifyCampaignInput to the successor; Hosting and every pre-existing Function remain bound to independently frozen baseline live identities and must be unchanged.
runtimeScenarioRegistryRule: The runtime registry is the canonical in-image SiteSift-canonical-JSON-v1 artifact. Its bootstrap, refutation, capability IDs, effects, launch class, review rubric, and expected verdict must exactly match this planning manifest; the route, runner, tests, and ranker load the same runtime bytes.

scenarioExecutionContract.modelRepeatRule: All three fresh run IDs must pass; never average. Bind prompt digest, requested model, provider-returned model, and stable fingerprint. An unresolved mutable alias or drift is INSTRUMENT_BLOCKED.
scenarioExecutionContract.humanReviewRule: Baylor reviews transient bounded synthetic text under the pinned rubric; durable evidence stores only body digest, rubric version, verdict, and safe reason.

scenarioTestMethodRule: test_<scenarioId with hyphens replaced by underscores>

bootstrapScenario.purpose: Prove the certification transport, isolated fixture, capture, replay, cleanup, and evidence chain before any capability pack is stamped.

refutationScenarios.purpose: Prove that the harness rejects one approved impossible expectation without accepting an oracle from the request.

scenarioDefinitionRule: The complete bootstrap, refutation, and exactly these 91 capability scenarios (93 total) must appear one-for-one in the in-image runtime registry. logicalFixtureKey and oracleProjectionKey are repository-safe aliases only; concrete client, recipient, Sheet, Drive, thread, and event identifiers come only from the bound numeric fixture-config secret. requiredEffects and forbiddenEffects are exact observed adapter/store projection cardinalities, never self-asserted success flags. No runtime scenario may inherit an omitted field or substitute a default.

coverageGaps: live Hosting and Functions source correlation
production-resident extraction and real fixture Sheet readback
production-resident parameter adapter and effect readback
production-resident fault injection and direct converged-state readback
production-resident integrated runner is not implemented

frontendArtifactRead.functionsProviderRead: for fn in analyzeSheetColumns generateAllScripts generateSecondaryScript regeneratePrimaryScript generateInitialScript getCampaignAccessState processOutboxOnCreate certifyCampaignInput; do gcloud functions describe $fn --gen2 --project email-automation-cache --region us-central1 --format=json; done; gcloud functions describe api --project email-automation-cache --region us-central1 --format=json
frontendArtifactRead.acceptance: frontendCertificationSourceAnchor must be a non-null reviewed successor before adapter use. Hosting remains bound to hostingSourceAnchor: read live release/version and official files[].path plus files[].hash, validate/normalize provider hash encoding to lowercase hex, canonicalize sorted {path,hash}, and match hostingPinnedCacheDigest; both public manifests remain byte-identical. Freeze every preExistingRequiredFunction provider identity before the adapter change and require it unchanged afterward; Gen1 api uses its frozen source-archive manifest. Deploy only certifyCampaignInput and require its independent provider package/source/revision/image, Node 20, region, dedicated service account, and private invoker to match the reviewed successor. Self-report/functions:list never establish identity. Missing or mismatched identity is INSTRUMENT_BLOCKED.
